newsitem.title: INDIA: India SEBI says to retain weekly stock price limit.
newsitem.headline: India SEBI says to retain weekly stock price limit.

text.p: Market regulator, the Securities & Exchange Board of India (SEBI) on Thursday said it would retain a weekly price limit on stock prices.

"There was an overall consensus that there was no need to remove the weekly cap of 25 percent as it served a useful purpose in containing volatility and thereby helping the safety of the market," SEBI said after a meeting of the Inter-Exchange Co-ordination group late on Thursday.
Major stock exchanges impose a 25 percent weekly limit on stock price increases to restrict market volatility.
The meeting of the exchange group was called after some exchanges suggested to SEBI that it revise the present limit in view of a favourable budget.

Indian stock markets have rallied over 10 percent this week after the government last Friday announced a set of market-boosting measures that included reduction in corporate and personal taxes and hiking foreign portfolio investment in some firms.
